title: THE TWO PARTY ARCADE SEATS ARE PLAYER 1 AND PLAYER 2 IN BOTH WINDOWS
why: His order of 2026-10-18: there seem to be a lot of inconsistencies between p1 and p2 games, please coordinate them better. The roster keeps the name each save had when the two windows linked, before the party arcade renamed them, so over a head, on the team bar and in the feed one window read a save name or Pillager where the other read Player 2. In the party arcade the two seats are now Player 1 and Player 2 in both windows; outside the arcade the roster names stand.
now: In the party arcade demo both windows now call the two players Player 1 and Player 2 over the heads, on the team bar and in the feed.
